title: rAthena channels.conf — chat channel definitions
description: JSON port of rAthena conf/channels.conf. Defines the global chat channels available to all players (main / map / guild / trade / system) and the private-channel creation policy. Loaded by Map.Server ChannelService.ReadConfig at boot. AT-F wave: rewrote the malformed DB-6-generated schema to match the corrected channels.json layout.

colors.description: Named color palette referenced by channel.color. Values are 0xRRGGBB integers; the low byte is what the client renders.

private_channel.description: Per-player private channel policy. Private channels are always CHAN_TYPE_PUBLIC and are id-namespaced starting at 1000.

allow.description: Allow players to create their own channel?

color.description: Default color name (must exist in colors).

delay.description: Chat delay (ms) between messages per member.

max_member.description: Maximum members the owner can have in a private channel.

self_notif.description: Show message to self when entering or leaving the channel.

join_notif.description: Notify channel members on any join.

leave_notif.description: Notify channel members on any leave.

color_override.description: Allow members to override the channel color with their personal color.

change_delay.description: Allow owner to change the chat delay at runtime.

channels.description: Pre-defined global channels seeded at boot. Each entry creates a chat room of the given type; players with autojoin=true get added on map-enter.

type.description: Channel type. CHAN_TYPE_PUBLIC = global; CHAN_TYPE_MAP = per-map filtered; CHAN_TYPE_ALLY = guild+allies only; CHAN_TYPE_PRIVATE = owner-managed.

autojoin.description: If true, players are added to this channel on map-enter (PlayerEntity.Autojoin).

leave.description: If true, members can leave at will. If false, members cannot leave (system / mandatory channel).
